verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a dashboard-based SaaS registrar, so this axis applies. The pack never documents an in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks. The llms.txt, OpenAPI spec and MCP server are external agent building blocks, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
